text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A Happy New Year to youuu!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees! Japanese New Year is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Osechi, mochi pounding, ozoni... Every 
single one is delicious!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
BUUUT, I want to celebrate Oshougatsu way, 
WAY more, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!! Isn't there any other fun way to 
spend NEW YEAR'S?!
choice_data_list:
Like deciding your resolutions for the 
year.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hofu! Grass said something like that too! 
I'm pretty sure it means an ambition or a 
goal!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course my goal is to become "Horse Girl 
of the Year," but――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What is your goal, Trainer? Is it to 
become a billionaire?!
choice_data_list: I'll help you seize your dream
I'll help you seize your dream!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! If Trainer's goal comes true, then my 
goal will come true too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Two bodies, one soul! Alright! Let's put 
our heads together and give 'em a show!"

We've settled on our resolutions. Now the 
question is what concrete steps to take 
next...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Weeell... to be specific...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Sowwy, I'm not good at thinking, YES!! I 
leave it to you, Trainer-san!"

Though my offer to cooperate was flatly 
rejected, in order to guide Taiki Shuttle 
to becoming "Horse of the Year"—
choice_data_list: Let's work on building up your speed.

When it's time to rest, make sure you rest 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Speeding UP, you say!? Leave it to ME! 
Speed is my biggest selling POINT, after 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... When you said "study," I was 
wondering what we were gonna do.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it's not like I'm bad at studying, 
you know? It's the truth, you know?

Wondering just how bad at studying she 
really was, I told her we should polish up 
her speed instead.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: J-Just how much do you know, Trainer-san!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to gather some friends for 
a non-stop party this New Year's, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay... I'll get plenty of rest. It's 
all to become Uma Musume of the Year, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Is it okay to party for just one day?

Since it would be bad if it interfered 
with training, I told her to keep it in 
moderation.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A weapon...? You mean a WEAPON?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Then it's a quick draw, YES! BANG BANG!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I'm also great with a lasso, yes! As 
for the rest...

"I explained that they weren't physical 
weapons and conveyed the importance of 
improving one's skills."
